name: Bard
description: A charismatic performer who inspires allies through song, story, and sheer force of personality.
hopeFeature: Rally — Spend 3 Hope to give an ally a Hope.

subclasses.name: Troubadour
subclasses.description: A wandering performer who carries tales from town to town.
features: Gain +1 to Presence rolls when performing.
Once per rest, inspire an ally to reroll a failed roll.

subclasses.name: Wordsmith
subclasses.description: A master of language and lore who wields words as weapons.
features: Your words can inflict Stress on enemies.
Gain access to Codex domain cards at level 1.

classFeatures.name: Rally
classFeatures.description: Spend 3 Hope to give an ally a Hope.

classFeatures.name: Performance
classFeatures.description: Use Presence to inspire, entertain, or manipulate crowds.

name: Druid
description: A guardian of nature who shapeshifts, heals, and commands the wild.
hopeFeature: Beastform — Transform into an animal form.

subclasses.name: Warden of the Elements
subclasses.description: Commands elemental forces of fire, water, earth, and air.
features: Channel elemental damage through nature magic.
Resistance to one element of your choice.

subclasses.name: Warden of Renewal
subclasses.description: Heals and restores life to wounded allies and blighted land.
features: Heal 1d4 HP to an ally as an action.
Purify corrupted natural spaces.

classFeatures.name: Wild Sense
classFeatures.description: Sense disturbances in the natural world nearby.

name: Guardian
description: A stalwart defender who stands between danger and those they protect.
hopeFeature: Frontline — Mark an enemy to draw their attention.

subclasses.name: Stalwart
subclasses.description: An immovable shield who absorbs punishment for the party.
features: Reduce incoming damage by 1 when marking an enemy.
+1 max HP per level.

subclasses.name: Vengeance
subclasses.description: Strikes back fiercely at those who harm allies.
features: When an ally takes damage, make a free counterattack.
Deal +1 damage to enemies who hit your allies.

classFeatures.name: Frontline
classFeatures.description: Mark an enemy to draw their attention.

classFeatures.name: Shield Bash
classFeatures.description: Knock an enemy back with your shield.

name: Ranger
description: A skilled hunter and tracker who thrives in the wilderness.
hopeFeature: Mark Target — Mark a target for bonus damage.

subclasses.name: Beastbound
subclasses.description: Bonds deeply with an animal companion who fights at their side.
features: Gain a loyal animal companion.
Share senses with your companion within Far range.

subclasses.name: Wayfinder
subclasses.description: Master of terrain and navigation who never loses their way.
features: Always know true north and nearest water source.
Travel twice as fast through familiar terrain.

classFeatures.name: Mark Target
classFeatures.description: Mark a target for bonus damage.

classFeatures.name: Track
classFeatures.description: Follow trails and identify creatures by their signs.

name: Rogue
description: A cunning operative who strikes from shadows and never fights fair.
hopeFeature: Cunning Action — Move or hide as a free action.

subclasses.name: Nightwalker
subclasses.description: Moves unseen through darkness, a ghost in the night.
features: Invisible in dim light or darkness while stationary.
Silent movement regardless of surface.

subclasses.name: Syndicate
subclasses.description: Connected to criminal networks with eyes everywhere.
features: Contacts in every major city.
Gain intel on targets through underworld connections.

classFeatures.name: Cunning Action
classFeatures.description: Move or hide as a free action.

classFeatures.name: Sneak Attack
classFeatures.description: Deal extra damage when attacking from hiding.

name: Seraph
description: A divine warrior channeling holy power to smite evil.
hopeFeature: Prayer — Spend Hope to heal an ally.

subclasses.name: Winged Sentinel
subclasses.description: Bears wings of light and soars above the battlefield.
features: Limited flight for short distances.
Radiate light that harms undead and shadow creatures.

subclasses.name: Prayer Warrior
subclasses.description: Channels divine wrath through fervent prayer.
features: Smite deals radiant damage.
Your prayers can banish minor demons.

classFeatures.name: Prayer
classFeatures.description: Spend Hope to heal an ally.

classFeatures.name: Divine Shield
classFeatures.description: Protect an ally with a barrier of holy light.

name: Sorcerer
description: Innate magic flows through their veins, raw and untamed.
hopeFeature: Arcane Sense — Sense magical auras nearby.

subclasses.name: Elemental Origin
subclasses.description: Magic tied to a primal element — fire, ice, storm, or stone.
features: Cast spells of your chosen element without components.
Resistance to your element.

subclasses.name: Primal Origin
subclasses.description: Raw, untamed magical power that surges unpredictably.
features: Critical spell hits trigger wild magic surges.
Spend Stress to boost spell damage.

classFeatures.name: Innate Casting
classFeatures.description: Cast spells through instinct rather than study.

name: Warrior
description: A master of weapons and combat who lives for the clash of steel.
hopeFeature: No Mercy — Deal extra damage to marked targets.

subclasses.name: Call of the Brave
subclasses.description: Leads from the front, inspiring courage in allies.
features: Allies within Close range gain +1 to attack rolls.
You cannot be frightened.

subclasses.name: Call of the Slayer
subclasses.description: Specializes in killing blows against powerful foes.
features: Deal double damage on killing blows.
Track and identify monster weaknesses.

classFeatures.name: No Mercy
classFeatures.description: Deal extra damage to marked targets.

classFeatures.name: Weapon Mastery
classFeatures.description: Gain expertise with your chosen weapon type.

name: Wizard
description: A studious spellcaster who masters arcane arts through rigorous study.
hopeFeature: Prepared Spells — Prepare spells from your grimoire.

subclasses.name: School of Knowledge
subclasses.description: Master of learned magic and arcane theory.
features: Identify any magical item on inspection.
Prepare one extra spell per rest.

subclasses.name: School of War
subclasses.description: Magic optimized for the chaos of battle.
features: Cast damaging spells as reactions.
Spells ignore half cover.

classFeatures.name: Arcane Recovery
classFeatures.description: Recover spent spell slots during a short rest.
